'''Mummy warriors''' are fought to obtain either a [[magic path key]] or a [[ranged path key]] in the [[Smoking Kills]] quest. These keys unlock the path to the [[Mighty Banshee]]. This monster only appears after the surrounding skeletons and zombies are dead.

==Habitat==
In the dungeon area up the broken stairs in the swamp near the [[Agility pyramid]] south of [[Nardah]].

==Drops==
{{DropLogProject|jagex=yes}}

===100%===
{{DropsTableHead}}
{{DropsLine|name=Magic path key|quantity=1|rarity=Always|raritynotes={{DropNote|Only dropped if the western path was taken.}}}}
{{DropsLine|name=Ranged path key|quantity=1|rarity=Always|raritynotes={{DropNote|Only dropped if the eastern path was taken.}}}}
{{DropsTableBottom}}

===Tertiary===
{{DropsTableHead}}
{{DropsLine|name=Mummy Champion's scroll|quantity=1|rarity=1/5000|altrarity=1/4000|raritynotes={{DropNote|Only dropped if you have access to the [[Champions' Guild]] and you have not defeated the [[Mummy Champion]] in [[Champion's Challenge]]. Chance increased to 1/4000 if a [[champion scroll enhancer]] is active.}}|gemw=No}}
{{DropsTableBottom}}
